summary: This is a routine earnings press release filed on Form 6-K by Scienjoy Holding Corporation, a foreign private issuer. It announces unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, with details on revenues, gross profit, net income, and cash position. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is mentioned. The filing is a standard quarterly update with no transactional or corporate-event triggers.
